title: Descend a marked curve diagram before final shrinking
statement: Let f:X→S be separated and finitely presented, η a component generic point, K/κ(η) a finite purely inseparable extension, L_i/K finitely many finite separable field extensions, and A_i→B_i→Spec L_i a specified finite diagram with A_i nonempty open in B_i, B_i smooth proper geometrically irreducible of dimension at most one. Suppose ν₀:∐A_i→X_η×K is a finite surjection compatible with the structure maps, and W₀ is open, dense in each A_i under inverse image, with ν₀ a thickening over W₀. There is an open neighbourhood U of η and finite surjective universally injective g:V→U carrying models T_i,Y_i,B'_i and a finite surjection ν:∐Y_i→X_V, commuting with their structure maps, such that T_i→V is finite etale, Y_i→B'_i is open, and B'_i→T_i is smooth proper. The original A_i,B_i,Spec L_i are recovered by cartesian squares along a specified σ:Spec K→V compatible with the canonical map into S, and the comparison arrows commute with j₀,q₀. There is an open W⊆X_V on which ν is a thickening. For every point s of T_i over η the fibre B'_{i,s} is geometrically connected of dimension at most one and s belongs to the image of the inverse-image marked open in Y_i. No assertion about the other fibres or global marked surjectivity is made. Empty finite families are allowed. proof.text: Apply unmarked finite-diagram descent to the supplied curves and finite surjection, without using W₀ or its properties. Retain the comparison σK, the three component pullback squares, the two compatibility equalities, and the pullback square for ν itself. This supplies all of the required model and generic-fibre properties except the marking.

Apply the finite closed-immersion locus theorem to the cartesian comparison between ν₀ and ν and the open W₀. It gives W on which ν is a closed immersion and whose inverse image contains W₀. Since ν is surjective, its base change over W is surjective; hence this restriction is a thickening.

Fix i and s in T_i over η. A point z of Spec K maps to η. Since g is universally injective and U→S is an open immersion, t_i(s)=σK(z). The pullback square for T_i supplies zL in Spec L_i mapping to s. The dense inverse image of W₀ in the nonempty A_i contains a point a. The coproduct pullback square and W₀⊆aX⁻¹W imply hA_i(a) lies in the marked inverse image. The two arrow-compatibility equations identify its image in T_i with hT_i(q₀_i(j₀_i(a))). Spec L_i is a singleton, so this equals hT_i(zL)=s. Thus the marked image contains s. This proof is vacuous for n=0 and uses no additional shrinking.

theorem exists_marked_curve_diagram_model
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (η : S) (hη : ∃ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents S, IsGenericPoint η Z)
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra (S.residueField η) K]
    [Module.Finite (S.residueField η) K] [IsPurelyInseparable (S.residueField η) K]
    (n : ℕ) (L : Fin n → Type u) [∀ i, Field (L i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (L i)]
    (A B : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (j₀ : ∀ i, A i ⟶ B i)
    (q₀ : ∀ i, B i ⟶ Spec (.of (L i)))
    (ν₀ : (∐ A) ⟶ pullback (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField η) K))))
    (hν₀ : IsFinite ν₀ ∧ Surjective ν₀)
    (hcomm : ∀ i, Sigma.ι A i ≫ ν₀ ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      j₀ i ≫ q₀ i ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (L i))))
    (hL : ∀ i, Module.Finite K (L i) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K (L i))
    (hj₀ : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j₀ i) ∧ Nonempty (A i))
    (hq₀ : ∀ i, Smooth (q₀ i) ∧ IsProper (q₀ i) ∧
      GeometricallyIrreducible (q₀ i) ∧ topologicalKrullDim (B i) ≤ 1)
    (W₀ : (pullback (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField η) K)))).Opens)
    (hW₀ : (∀ i, Dense ((Sigma.ι A i ≫ ν₀) ⁻¹' (W₀ : Set _))) ∧
      IsThickening (pullback.snd ν₀ W₀.ι)) :
    ∃ (U : S.Opens) (_ : η ∈ U) (V : Scheme.{u}) (g : V ⟶ U.toScheme),
      IsFinite g ∧ Surjective g ∧ UniversallyInjective g ∧
      ∃ (T Y Ybar : Fin n → Scheme.{u})
        (t : ∀ i, T i ⟶ V) (j : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ Ybar i)
        (p : ∀ i, Ybar i ⟶ T i)
        (ν : (∐ Y) ⟶ pullback f (g ≫ U.ι)),
        IsFinite ν ∧ Surjective ν ∧
        (∀ i, Sigma.ι Y i ≫ ν ≫ pullback.snd f (g ≫ U.ι) = j i ≫ p i ≫ t i) ∧
        (∀ i, IsFinite (t i) ∧ Etale (t i)) ∧
        (∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)) ∧
        (∀ i, Smooth (p i) ∧ IsProper (p i)) ∧
        (∃ (σK : Spec (.of K) ⟶ V)
          (hA : ∀ i, A i ⟶ Y i) (hB : ∀ i, B i ⟶ Ybar i)
          (hT : ∀ i, Spec (.of (L i)) ⟶ T i),
          σK ≫ g ≫ U.ι = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (algebraMap (S.residueField η) K)) ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField η ∧
          ∀ i,
            IsPullback (hA i) (j₀ i ≫ q₀ i ≫
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (L i))))
              (j i ≫ p i ≫ t i) σK ∧
            IsPullback (hB i) (q₀ i ≫
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (L i)))) (p i ≫ t i) σK ∧
            IsPullback (hT i) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (L i))))
              (t i) σK ∧
            hA i ≫ j i = j₀ i ≫ hB i ∧ hB i ≫ p i = q₀ i ≫ hT i) ∧
        ∃ W : (pullback f (g ≫ U.ι)).Opens,
          IsThickening (pullback.snd ν W.ι) ∧
          ∀ i (s : T i), (t i ≫ g ≫ U.ι) s = η →
            GeometricallyConnected ((p i).fiberToSpecResidueField s) ∧
            topologicalKrullDim ((p i).fiber s) ≤ 1 ∧
            s ∈ Set.range (((Sigma.ι Y i ≫ ν) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ j i ≫ p i)
